title: Unread contract case
description: One unread/thread rule both clients (web and the app) must agree on: a starting state, a sequence of abstract acts, and what the client sends and shows. See README.md in this directory.

formatVersion.description: Version of this format. A loader skips (and reports) a case whose version it does not know.

id.description: Same as the file name without `.json`.

rule.description: The rule in the #proj-mobile:#70 inventory (R1..R12) or a display gap (S1..).

why.description: Why the rule is what it is, in a sentence or two.

status.description: `agreed`: `expect` is the rule. `pending-product-decision`: the clients differ and nobody has chosen yet; `decision.candidates` records each candidate and loaders skip-and-report the case.

sources.description: Where each side implements the rule today (paths, optionally with line numbers). Documentation only.

knownGaps.description: An agreed rule a client does not follow yet. That client's loader skips the case and reports the reason; the gap is removed when the client is fixed.

steps.description: Acts in order. May be empty: then the case is about how `given` is shown.

checkpoints.description: Expectations part-way through (after a given step).

followUp.description: Task or PR that closes the gap.

conversation.description: The conversation the case is about. Its `id` is the one in request paths and event payloads.

openThread.description: The thread the person has open (its conversation id) when the case starts.

jumpTarget.description: The unread followed thread a jump pill targets, as the followed-threads list describes it. `null` = the field is absent (an older server).

row.description: The conversation's row inputs, as the unread summary and the client's stores hold them.

unread.description: The conversation's own unread count (a seq distance, not a row count).

threads.description: Followed threads under it with unread replies (threads, not replies).

hasNew.description: The summary's `hasNew`: a not-joined channel with messages past the cursor (no exact count).

mention.description: An unread mention of the person.

oneOf.description: The person picks Mark as Unread.

surface.description: threadMenu: the open thread's own menu (header or a message in it). activityRow: an Activity row's menu or swipe. conversationRow: a sidebar/Home row's menu. channelMessage: a message's menu in the open channel.

oneOf.description: The server answers the earliest request that has no answer yet.

from.description: olderServer: an answer from a server older than the current contract (not checked against it).

type.description: The socket event name, e.g. read_state:updated.

oneOf.description: A reply from someone else arrives in the open thread. visible: it is on screen, so an auto-read would fire.
The person leaves the open thread (closes it or opens another one).
The person taps the jump-to-unread-thread pill for `given.jumpTarget`.
The jump to the thread's parent finishes. historyLimited: it landed on the history paywall instead of the parent.

request.description: A mutating request (GET requests are never asserted).

path.description: The server path including /api, with the given ids.

state.description: What the client shows. Only the listed keys are asserted.

outcome.description: What the Mark as Unread answer means: counted, marked, nothing, or pending (202: admitted, result unknown).

unreadState.description: The unread state an act leaves on the conversation: none, a number, or the marked-unread dot. How a row draws it (given joined/muted) is rowDisplay.

toast.description: The toast shown by the last act, by abstract id (markUnreadNothing, markUnreadFailed), or null for none.

holdActive.description: Auto-read is held for the conversation (it stays unread while open).

threadUnreadCleared.description: The thread's unread was read away (locally and with the server).

rowDisplay.description: How the conversation's sidebar/Home row shows unread.

kind.description: loud: the pink count badge. quiet: a grey number. newDot: the quiet dot of a not-joined channel with new messages. markedDot: the quiet dot of a marked-unread row. none.

segments.description: The numbers shown; an absent segment is not shown.

unreadTone.description: The row's name is in the unread (bold) tone.

requests.description: Every mutating request sent since the case started, in order. Absent = not asserted; [] = none.

currentBehaviourOf.description: The clients that behave like this today.
